title: Machine learning-based fast charging of lithium-ion battery by perceiving and regulating internal microscopic states
evidence_area: machine learning-based fast charging strategy with multi-physical awareness within a battery-to-cloud framework
evidence_method: soft actor-critic (SAC) deep reinforcement learning algorithm is exploited to train a fast charging strategy
evidence_valid: Hardware-in-Loop tests and experiments with practical LIBs are carried out for validation
comment: Full abstract via Chalmers record. Reduced-order electrochemical-thermal model is the RL environment (not in loss) - RL carries the headline; alt Hybrid physics+ML. Chemistry not stated; no train/test split protocol, validation is HIL/experimental.

title: Remaining useful life prediction of lithium battery based on deep reinforcement learning fusion network
evidence_area: Deep Reinforcement Learning Fusion Network (DRLFN) for predicting the RUL of lithium batteries
evidence_method: integrates LSTM and Transformer for preliminary RUL predictions, then fused and optimized using a Deep Q-Network
evidence_valid: distinguishes regular and irregular prediction regions based on the spatial distribution of prediction errors in the validation set
comment: Full abstract via RePEc/IDEAS. Dataset = MIT-Stanford-Toyota (Severson) -> LFP coded from dataset knowledge. Validation set mentioned but train/test cell isolation not described -> v1.1 rule 4 not reported.

title: Identifying degradation patterns of lithium ion batteries from impedance spectroscopy using machine learning
evidence_area: Forecasting the state of health and remaining useful life ... EIS ... with Gaussian process machine learning
evidence_method: Our Gaussian process model takes the entire spectrum as input, without further feature engineering
evidence_valid: We use 25C01-25C04, 35C01 and 45C01 cells as the training group, and the others as the testing group
comment: Full text (Nature PDF). Dual headline - capacity (SOH) and RUL prediction - genuinely cross-functional per codebook priority rule. Commercial LCO/graphite cells. Own 20k-spectrum EIS dataset -> EIS-lab per v1.1 rule 3 tie-break. Test cells entirely held out.

title: A Comprehensive Review of Multiple Physical and Data-Driven Model Fusion Methods for Accurate Lithium-Ion Battery Inner State Factor Estimation
evidence_area: reviews the fusion application between physics-based and data-driven models for state of charge, state of health, and state of power
evidence_method: This paper reviews the fusion application between physics-based and data-driven models in lithium-ion battery management
evidence_valid: critically analyzes the advantages, limitations, and applicability of fusion models; no primary validation
comment: Full text (MDPI). v1.1 rule 5: cross-function review (SOC/SOH/SOP) -> Cross-cutting + Review / perspective; dominant reviewed family = Hybrid physics+ML (physics+data-driven fusion), recorded here per rule.

title: Data-Driven Fast Charging Optimization for Lithium-Ion Battery Using Bayesian Optimization With Fast Convergence
evidence_area: data-driven fast-charging optimization scheme using Bayesian optimization with fast convergence
evidence_method: hybrid Bayesian optimization algorithm by combining mesh grid adaptive search
evidence_valid: Different search strategies and acquisition functions are evaluated on multiple constant charge protocols
comment: Abstract-only. Model-free black-box optimization over battery test data (test-time/cost-of-cells framing) -> own tests assumed, self-lab. No split protocol - environment coded experimental hardware; chemistry not stated.

title: Untangling Degradation Chemistries of Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries Through Interpretable Hybrid Machine Learning
evidence_area: accurately forecast lithium-sulfur batteries (with a test mean absolute error of 8.9 % for the end-of-life prediction)
evidence_method: interpretable hybrid machine learning framework to untangle intractable degradation chemistries
evidence_valid: test mean absolute error of 8.9 % for the end-of-life prediction
comment: Abstract-only. Title word "hybrid" = interpretable ML plus physical-understanding generation; no physics model coupled in the architecture per codebook border rule -> Shallow ML (tabular, interpretable). Dataset composition not stated - self-lab assumed (flagged). Test-set isolation not described -> v1.1 rule 4 not reported.

title: Interpretable machine learning for battery capacities prediction and coating parameters analysis
evidence_area: interpretable machine learning framework ... predict battery product properties ... at the battery early-manufacturing stage
evidence_method: predict battery product properties and explain dynamic effects ... interactions of manufacturing parameters
evidence_valid: three types of battery capacities ... accurately predicted with R2 over 0.98 (no protocol reported)
comment: Abstract-only. v1.1 rule 2: coating-stage manufacturing QC -> Production & quality. Data collected from a real battery manufacturing chain -> self-lab. Split protocol not described -> v1.1 rule 4 not reported.

title: Physical informed neural network for SOH estimation of lithium-ion battery with electrochemical mechanism
evidence_area: Physical informed neural network for SOH estimation of lithium-ion battery with electrochemical mechanism
evidence_method: PDE, boundary condition, initial condition and SOH physical loss jointly guide learning (physics embedded in the loss)
evidence_valid: Experimental validation on three public datasets (XJTU, MIT, and HUST); six testing scenarios with different data volumes
comment: Abstract fragments (round-1 archived abstract). Physics in loss -> Physics-informed. Three public datasets pooled -> data mixed; chemistries span sources (MIT LFP among them) -> mixed. Cell-isolation protocol not described -> v1.1 rule 4 not reported.

title: Deep learning-driven detection of lithium-plating-type defects for battery manufacturing via formation and capacity grading data
evidence_area: detection of lithium-plating-type defects ... via formation and capacity grading data (battery manufacturing)
evidence_method: dual-task deep learning model: reconstruction task learns latent representations ... classification task identifies defective batteries
evidence_valid: recall of 97.14 % for defective batteries and overall accuracy of 97.42 % (no protocol reported)
comment: Abstract-only. v1.1 rule 2: manufacturing defect detection via formation/grading -> Production & quality (round-1 Fault & safety was the closest v1.0 bucket). Formation/grading data from 154 batteries of the manufacturing chain -> self-lab. Split protocol unstated -> v1.1 rule 4 not reported.

title: The development of machine learning-based remaining useful life prediction for lithium-ion batteries
evidence_area: thoroughly investigates the developmental trend of RUL prediction with machine learning algorithms
evidence_method: objective screening and statistics of related papers over the past decade (ten most used ML algorithms)
evidence_valid: literature synthesis; no primary validation
comment: Abstract-only. Single-function (RUL) review keeps function with Review / perspective per codebook review-handling rule.

title: Temperature prediction of lithium-ion battery based on artificial neural network model
evidence_area: temperature prediction of lithium-ion batteries in the metal foam thermal management system
evidence_method: BP-NN, RBF-NN and Elman neural networks were respectively applied to establish the temperature prediction model
evidence_valid: performance tests under the sample condition and the new condition were carried out respectively
comment: Abstract-only. Shallow nets (BP/RBF/Elman) on engineered inputs. Generalization tested under "the new condition" read as an unseen-condition (domain-shift) evaluation -> cross-domain holdout; flagged - if the new-condition data entered training, the environment reading (experimental hardware) applies. Chemistry not stated; training data from own metal-foam BTMS tests.

title: Rethinking lithium-ion battery management: Eliminating routine cell balancing enhances hazardous fault detection
evidence_area: Eliminating routine cell balancing enhances hazardous fault detection (headline architecture claim)
evidence_method: Charging algorithm designed to maximise energy throughput while accommodating varying capacity, impedance and aging of individual cells (no learned component)
evidence_valid: Extensive cycle testing on a range of different battery configurations
comment: Round-1 full-text read; notes reused in round-2 shared evidence. No ML anywhere -> v1.1 rule 1 Not ML (physics/classical). Balancing-elimination BMS-design claim is the headline; fault-detection gain is a consequence. Chemistries LFP (HEADWAY, CALB), LCO (GP1865), Panasonic/Samsung, Nissan modules -> mixed.

title: Explainability-driven model improvement for SOH estimation of lithium-ion battery
evidence_area: explainability-driven model improvement framework for lithium-ion battery SOH estimation
evidence_method: LRP relevance scores are embedded into the optimization procedure to guide model training (CNN/LSTM/Transformer backbones)
evidence_valid: released code excludes the test battery from training (leave-one-battery-out loaders); validated on different datasets and backbones
comment: Abstract + complete released code (wang-fujin/Explainability-driven_SOH) inspected: BIT/CALCE/MIT loaders with held-out test battery -> cross-cell holdout; datasets pooled -> mixed; deep backbones -> Deep learning. Chemistry: CALCE LCO + MIT LFP + BIT own -> mixed.

title: Machine Learning in Lithium‐Ion Battery Cell Production: A Comprehensive Mapping Study
evidence_area: state-of-the-art applications of machine learning within the domain of lithium-ion battery cell production
evidence_method: Based on a systematic mapping study, this comprehensive review details the state-of-the-art
evidence_valid: compiled findings derived from multi-perspective comparisons; no primary validation
comment: Abstract-only. v1.1 rules 2+5: production-domain mapping review -> Production & quality + Review / perspective.

title: Optimized charging of lithium-ion battery for electric vehicles: Adaptive multistage constant current–constant voltage charging strategy
evidence_area: adaptive multistage constant current-constant voltage (MCCCV) strategy for charging electric vehicles
evidence_method: optimization of the charging current using particle swarm optimization on a coupled thermoelectric-aging model
evidence_valid: high-fidelity thermoelectric-aging coupling model (electrical, thermal network, semiempirical aging); strategy results by model evaluation
comment: Full abstract (S2). PSO over physics models, no learned component (PSO tunes a charging strategy, not a network) -> Optimization-augmented control. No experiments reported in accessible text -> simulation; chemistry not stated.

title: Energy-Efficient Battery Thermal Management in Electric Vehicles Using Artificial-Neural-Network-Based Model Predictive Control
evidence_area: Model Predictive Control (MPC) strategy for the Battery Thermal Management System (BTMS) in electric vehicles
evidence_method: artificial neural network (ANN)-based model was designed ... infinity-horizon MPC framework
evidence_valid: evaluated using a simulation environment against a conventional rule-based controller
comment: Full text (MDPI). ANN surrogate inside MPC; control is the headline claim -> Optimization-augmented control per codebook (MPC/surrogate co-design); alt Deep learning. Chemistry not stated; Simscape model generates the data -> simulation.

title: Deep learning to estimate lithium-ion battery state of health without additional degradation experiments
evidence_area: deep-learning framework to enable the estimation of battery state of health without additional degradation experiments
evidence_method: integrates a swarm of deep neural networks equipped with domain adaptation
evidence_valid: cross-dataset battery SOH estimation without knowing any SOH labels of target batteries
comment: Full text (Nature PDF). Domain adaptation is the headline architecture -> Transfer learning per codebook boundary example (domain-adversarial SOH -> Transfer learning). Five cathode materials -> mixed; two self-developed + three public datasets -> mixed; target domain (dataset) held out -> cross-domain holdout.

title: Battery SOC estimation from EIS data based on machine learning and equivalent circuit model
evidence_area: SOC estimation approach based on EIS and an equivalent circuit model
evidence_method: equivalent circuit model to provide a compact way to describe the frequency- and time-domain impedance behavior
evidence_valid: experimentally validated on a dataset consisting of EIS measurements performed on four lithium-ion cylindrical cells (accuracy above 93 %)
comment: Full abstract. ECM+ML SOC from EIS -> Hybrid physics+ML per codebook boundary example. Own EIS dataset on four cylindrical cells -> EIS-lab; chemistry not stated. Split protocol not described -> v1.1 rule 4 not reported.

title: Machine Learning-Based Data-Driven Fault Detection/Diagnosis of Lithium-Ion Battery: A Critical Review
evidence_area: comprehensive review exclusively on the state-of-the-art ML-based data-driven fault detection/diagnosis techniques
evidence_method: reviews ML-based techniques over model-based, knowledge-based and signal-processing-based fault diagnosis methods
evidence_valid: synthesis with current issues and future challenges; no primary validation
comment: Full text (MDPI). Single-function (fault detection/diagnosis) review keeps function with Review / perspective.

title: Novel state of charge estimation method of containerized Lithium–Ion battery energy storage system based on deep learning
evidence_area: novel deep learning SOC estimation method based on the attention mechanism (A) and CNN-LSTM network
evidence_method: CNN layers extract the critical features ... LSTM layers capture the long-term dependencies ... attention assigns weights
evidence_valid: comparative experiments of three datasets and ablation study are carried out
comment: Abstract + publisher front matter. Containerized (stationary) BESS plant - "The actual energy storage plant is described in Section 2" -> v1.1 rule 3 field-stationary. Split protocol not described -> v1.1 rule 4 not reported; chemistry not stated.

title: Estimation of lithium-ion battery electrochemical properties from equivalent circuit model parameters using machine learning
evidence_area: digital twin of an electric vehicle battery ... improve battery state estimation accuracy, optimize battery usage, and achieve more advanced prognostics
evidence_method: neural network ... correlating them to critical electrochemical parameters of a Pseudo-Two-Dimensional PBM
evidence_valid: trained and validated on a synthetic dataset generated using a Pseudo-Two-Dimensional PBM (60/10/30 random record split)
comment: Full text (author-deposited published PDF via Zenodo). Stated purpose spans state estimation, usage optimization and prognostics -> genuinely cross-functional -> Cross-cutting. ECM+P2D+NN pipeline; physics supplies synthetic training data, not a loss term -> Hybrid physics+ML. Prismatic graphite/LiMn2O4 cell -> LMO. Headline validation in simulation; record-level split is not a cell-isolation protocol.

title: Lithium-ion battery remaining useful life prediction based on interpretable deep learning and network parameter optimization
evidence_area: remaining useful life prediction combined with interpretable deep learning and network parameter optimization
evidence_method: fused deep learning model (CNN+LSTM); interpretable algorithm quantifies feature contributions; network parameter optimization
evidence_valid: Four batteries constitute the training set, and the residual one battery is used as the testing set in every batch
comment: Round-1 full-text read; notes reused in round-2 shared evidence. Dataset = Stanford-MIT (Severson) LFP/A123 cells -> LFP, Severson-MATR. Per-batch train-4/test-1 battery split -> cross-cell holdout.

title: Battery health features extraction and state of health estimation based on real-time online vehicle driving data
evidence_area: battery health features extraction and state of health estimation based on real-time online vehicle driving data
evidence_method: Bayesian Optimization-XGBoost-Attention Mechanism (BO-XGBoost-AM) ... compared with XGBoost, PSO-LSTM, GRU, ETR and GPR
evidence_valid: A dataset spanning 7 months utilized to validate; day-based division strategy optimal with 3-day interval (MAE/RMSE/MAPE below 3.2 %)
comment: Abstract-only. XGBoost ensemble carries the headline (BO tunes hyperparameters) -> Shallow ML; real-vehicle fleet data -> real-vehicle. Day-based temporal division of same-fleet data is described; vehicle/cell-level isolation is not -> within-cell split; deployed operation not evidenced -> online/real-vehicle not credited (flagged).

title: Transfer Learning-Based Lithium-Ion Battery State of Health Estimation With Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy
evidence_area: transfer learning-based lithium-ion battery SOH estimation method using explainable electrochemical impedance spectroscopy
evidence_method: a transfer learning strategy is added to estimate the SOH of the target cell by fine-tuning the initial model parameters
evidence_valid: fine-tuning the initial model parameters on different temperatures and different types of cells to estimate the SOH of the target cell
comment: Full abstract (Semantic Scholar). TL is the headline differentiator (title) -> Transfer learning. ECM-fitted EIS features + spatiotemporal LSTM; two public EIS datasets -> EIS-lab; cell types/chemistries unspecified -> various. Temperature-regime + cell-type shift -> cross-domain holdout per codebook definition.

title: A multi-fault diagnosis method for lithium-ion battery pack using curvilinear Manhattan distance evaluation and voltage difference analysis
evidence_area: rapid multi-fault diagnosis methodology ... detect, locate and determine fault types for sudden and progressive faults
evidence_method: based on curvilinear Manhattan distance and voltage difference analysis technique (no learning model)
evidence_valid: Diagnosis experiments are implemented based on the aging data of the series-connected lithium-ion battery pack
comment: Abstract-only. No learned component (distance metric + voltage-difference criteria) -> v1.1 rule 1 Not ML (physics/classical). Pack aging campaign data -> self-lab; chemistry not stated. Rule-based method on physical pack data -> experimental hardware.

title: Performance analysis on liquid-cooled battery thermal management for electric vehicles based on machine learning
evidence_area: automatic calibration model ... to predict cooling capacity and system coefficient of performance (COP) by support vector regression (SVR)
evidence_method: PSO algorithm is introduced to optimize the three hyper parameters of the SVR model
evidence_valid: Datasets randomly separated into training and test datasets: 80 % training, 20 % test
comment: Round-1 full-text read; notes reused in round-2 shared evidence. PSO-tuned SVR; SVR carries the headline -> Shallow ML. Experimental BTMS+HPACS rig data -> self-lab; chemistry not stated. Random 80/20 record-level split, no isolation -> within-cell split.

title: Machine learning pipeline for battery state-of-health estimation
evidence_area: machine learning pipeline for estimation of battery capacity fade - a metric of battery health - on 179 cells
evidence_method: GPR, RF, BRR and deep NN on 30 engineered features; automatic feature selection (RF-RFE with cross-validation)
evidence_valid: cells grouped by charging protocol; separate model training and performance assessment per group; battery-count cross-validations
comment: Accepted manuscript (preprint, U. Glasgow archive). 179 cells from multiple sources and chemistries (NASA/TRI/Oxford/LG Chem/A123) -> mixed for chem and data. Battery-level (leave-one-battery-out style) evaluation -> cross-cell holdout.

title: Towards a smarter battery management system: A critical review on deep learning-based state of charge estimation of lithium-ion batteries
evidence_area: structured review on deep learning-based SOC estimation of lithium-ion batteries
evidence_method: detailed taxonomy of SOC estimation approaches ... systematic walk-through ... frequently applied optimization strategies
evidence_valid: appeal for a standardized evaluation protocol in this field; no primary validation
comment: Full abstract (DOAJ). Single-function (SOC) review keeps function with Review / perspective.

title: Early prediction of battery lifetime via a machine learning based framework
evidence_area: accurate early-cycle prediction of battery lifetime ... machine learning based framework
evidence_method: forty-two features are manually crafted based on the first-100-cycle charge-discharge raw data ... fed into six representative ML models
evidence_valid: A stratified random sampling method is used to split the dataset, and this is repeated 20 times to reduce the randomness
comment: Full abstract (Semantic Scholar) + round-1 archived-page evidence. Each cell is one sample (first-100-cycle features -> lifetime), so the stratified random split is cell-level -> cross-cell holdout. Severson MIT/Stanford LFP/A123 cohort -> LFP, Severson-MATR.

title: Lithium-Ion Battery Pack Robust State of Charge Estimation, Cell Inconsistency, and Balancing: Review
evidence_area: state of the art of battery pack SOC estimation methods ... impact of cell inconsistency; balancing discussed as consequence
evidence_method: four categories of pack SOC estimation methods compared by algorithm type, computational load and engineering effort
evidence_valid: review synthesis; no primary validation reported
comment: Full text (IEEE OA). Pack-SOC is the dominant function (balancing/inconsistency secondary) -> single-function review rule keeps State estimation (SOC).
